entries.title: Genesis 17:1
segments:
Perfect; sincere, upright, wholly and perseveringly devoted to the service and glory of God. 
 
Though the fulfilment of divine promises may be long delayed, yet in due time they will all be accomplished; for God is almighty, he can do all his pleasure; and none who continue patiently to trust in, and obey him, will in the end be disappointed.

entries.title: Genesis 17:5
segments: Abram; this word means a high or distinguished father
Abraham; by this change in the Hebrew word it means a father of great multitudes.

entries.title: Genesis 17:8
segments: Everlasting possession; to the end of time, if perseveringly obedient to God.

entries.title: Genesis 17:10
segments: This is my covenant; the token or seal of it which they should continue to observe.

Circumcision was "a seal of the righteousness which Abraham had yet being uncircumcised, that he might be the father of all them that believe."  It was designed to impress on the mind the necessity of obeying God, not outwardly merely, but in heart; of serving him who is a Spirit, in spirit and in truth.

entries.title: Genesis 17:11
segments: Circumcise; this word means, to cut around.

entries.title: Genesis 17:13
segments:
My covenant; the token or sign of it. 
 
  Everlasting covenant; a covenant which they should continue to observe from generation to generation, and the benefits of which to all the truly obedient would be eternal.  The apostle Paul shows,

, that all believers in Christ are the spiritual children of Abraham, and partakers of the spiritual blessings of the covenant which God made with him. 
 
It is the will of God that servants, as well as masters and their children, should have the means of grace, be instructed in the way of life, and be treated in all respects as rational, accountable, and immortal beings, for whom Christ died, and who, through faith in him, may shine as the brightness of the firmament and as the stars for ever.

entries.title: Genesis 17:14
segments: Cut off; this expression denotes, in general, the death of the offender; but the manner is not specified.  His outward and visible destruction was a solemn symbol of his everlasting separation from God's holy family.

entries.title: Genesis 17:15
segments: Sarah; meaning princess; that is, of royal families to spring from her.

entries.title: Genesis 17:17
segments: Laughed; an expression of believing joy.

entries.title: Genesis 17:18
segments:
Might live; prosper and be blessed in his person and posterity. 
 
As God is the author of parental affection, he delights in its exercise, and in answering the hearty, fervent prayers of parents for their children.

entries.title: Genesis 17:19
segments: Isaac; meaning laughter--joy in view of the blessings bestowed on him.

entries.title: Genesis 17:23
segments: True and lively faith not only trusts the promises of God, but yields prompt, implicit, and hearty obedience to God's commands.  It thus shows itself by words, and by works is faith made perfect.
